title: Haunted One
html:
Haunted One is a character background unique to the Dark Urge with inspirations themed around embracing (or sometimes resisting) The Urge.

“
A wicked moment, person, or thing that cannot be slain by sword or spell haunts your mind and flickers in your peripheral vision. You carry it wherever your adventure takes you - or perhaps it carries you.
„

Background features

  • Medicine Proficiency: Gain Proficiency with  Wisdom (Medicine) Ability Checks.
  • Intimidation Proficiency: Gain Proficiency with  Charisma (Intimidation) Ability Checks.

Background goals

Performing certain actions that align with this background rewards Inspiration Points. These goals can be accomplished by any member of the active party, and Inspiration Points are pooled, up to a maximum of 4. Completing an inspiration event also grants experience to the  Dark Urge. While not necessarily all-inclusive, listed below are known events which grant inspiration points to Dark Urge characters.

Location XP Reward Name Description
General
Anywhere 25 Indulge Thine Appetites Follow your Dark Urge.
  • There are many opportunities to obtain this version, generally by choosing dialogue options related to giving in to the urges, but only the first time this is done actually grants an Inspiration Point.
  • Interaction catalysts include: Killing Gale, Timber, Arabella, Wounded Bird, Okta, Remira, Pandirna, Zevlor, Lady Esther, Blood of Lathander, and the Strange Ox in Act 2, among others.
50 Killing Spree Kill 5 enemies in a single round.
50 Panoply of Agony Get at least one kill with each Damage type.
  • There are thirteen different damage types.
25 Subdue Thine Appetites Resist your Dark Urge.
  • There are many opportunities to obtain this version, generally by choosing dialogue options related to refusing to give in to the urges, but only the first time this is done actually grants an inspiration point.
  • Interaction catalysts include: Saving Gale, Okta, Arabella, and Sa'varsh Kethk, among others.
95 Unfriendly Fire Defeat 5 neutral creatures in a single round.
Act 1
Blighted Village 25 Creatures of Bloodlust Recruit the ogre mercenaries, using the corpses of your enemies as payment.
  • Shared with ⁠Bodyguards for Hire and ⁠Pyramid Scheme.
Campsite 25 Snipping the Chords Kill Alfira in cold blood.
  • Killing Quil Grootslang instead of Alfira does not count.
Dank Crypt 20 Unfamiliar Familiarity Release Withers from his tomb.
Druids Grove 50 Camaraderie in Bloodthirst Spill the blood of the tieflings.
50 Morally Acceptable Massacre Spill the blood of the goblins.
Forest 25 Reuniting Friends Kill Brynna and Andrick, reuniting them with their fallen companion.
Goblin Camp 25 Good Ol' Long Pig Eat a chunk of the cooked dwarf.
25 Grabbing the Poker with Both Hands Torture Liam.
  • The option to torture Liam is not available to Drow characters. To do this, they must be disguised as anyone but a drow.[verify]
25 Now It's a Party! Poison the stolen ale, slaughtering the goblins.
  • Shared with ⁠Culling the Crowd and ⁠Spiked.
Grymforge 50 Head of the Snake Take Nere's head.
Ravaged Beach 20 To Sleep, Perchance To Dream Tentacled Dreams Close the pinned mind flayer's eyes forever.
Underdark 50 New Management Kill the Myconid Sovereign for Glut.
Waukeen's Rest 30 Fresh Kindle for the Fire Leave the pinned Benryn to burn.
  • Freeing Benryn but letting him die from the fire before he escapes counts.
Act 2
Gauntlet of Shar 75 Bleeding the Corpse Dry Kill the necromancer.
75 Blood Moon Kill the Daughter of the Moon.
75 Killer Poetry Trick the orthon with a false loophole.
  • Requires the interacting party member to succeed a passive  DC 14 Insight Check in the initial dialogue with Yurgir to detect a tricky clause in the text of the contract. Bards and Warlocks pass this check automatically.
  • Shared with the ⁠The Devil's in the Details inspiration.
75 Self-Flagellation Kill your mirror-self in Shar's trial.
  • Shared with the ⁠Know Thine Enemy inspiration.
Last Light Inn 75 Forced Retirement End Jaheira's career permanently.
75 Lunar Eclipse Kill the protector of Last Light.
Mind Flayer Colony 95 Lesser of the Three Kill the envoy of Myrkul.
Moonrise Towers 50 Too Easy Execute the useless goblins.
60 Swimming with the Shadows Force the Zhent smuggler to jump off the docks.
60 Who Let the Gnolls Out Release the gnolls from their leashes.
Moonrise Towers Prison 60 Soulful Lobotomy Torture Minthara, reducing her to a husk of her former self.
  • Obtained if the Urge personally erases Minthara's mind; letting the Inquisitors do it does not grant an inspiration point.
Reithwin Town 60 Lack of Moderation is Key Kill the brewer with his own brew.
60 Under the Knife Kill the surgeon using his own servile nurses.
Shadow-Cursed Lands 50 Fly-Swatter Kill the trickster pixie.
  • This can also be triggered by arriving to Moonrise Towers with Kar'niss' convoy.
50 Forcing Responsibility Demand that the goblin fetch his bone.
Act 3
Bhaal Temple 275 Bhaalspawn No More Reject your legacy.
75 Forced Retirement End Jaheira's career permanently.
  • This inspiration can be earned here, if the Dark Urge embraces their Bhaalspawn legacy and Jaheira survives to this moment. In this case, she and Minsc confront the party upon leaving the temple.
220 Homecoming Discover the Temple of Bhaal beneath Baldur's Gate.
275 Return of the Bhaalspawn Embrace your legacy.
220 Securing Your Line Become the primary descendant of Bhaal.
  • Shared with the ⁠Putting the Past to Rest inspiration
Lower City 220 A Massacre Beyond Imagining Annihilate the Steel Watch Foundry with Wulbren's secret weapon.
220 An Overdue Slaughter Pull off a long-overdue climax to the life of Mystic Carrion.
170 Culling the Imitator Kill the wannabe assassin.
220 Re-tasting the Kill Kill Ethel a second time - that stubborn, swampy scandal of a hag.
  • Despite mentioning a second time, this inspiration is rewarded even if Ethel was not killed in Act One.
  • Shared with ⁠Double-Tap and ⁠Estrangement of Ethel inspirations.
170 Weak Gifts for Weak Beings Take the measly offerings to the gods for yourself.
170 Written in Blood Accept Orin's proposition of alliance.
Murder Tribunal 220 A Step Too Far Save Valeria, rejecting Bhaal's gifts.
220 Death of Innocence Become the Unholy Assassin of Bhaal.
275 Spawn Cleanup Crew Defeat Bhaal's wretched legacy.
Rivington 170 Cleaning Up The Scum Kill both of the opposing smuggling factions.
135 First of Many Request a statue of your mortal form.
135 Kill 'Em While They're Young Execute the newborn mind flayer.
135 Personal Relations Meet one of Orin's impersonations.
170 Trail of Blood Collect all the pieces of Dribbles.
135 Unexpected Parenting Feed a brain to the newborn mind flayer.
Upper City 220 How High They Fall Kill the egotistic would-be immortal.
Wyrm's Crossing 135 Exsanguinated Ecstacy Accept Naoise's lewd proposition.
Wyrm's Rock Fortress 220 Shattering the Black Hand Kill the would-be Tyrant.
